method.unit: probability; multiply by 100 for percentage points
method.aggregation: Average all repeats within each task and round, subtract round 0 from round 2 within task, then average over tasks.
method.scoring: Same parser and plurality tie-break as recompute_debate.py
method.missingness: Unanimity requires every slot to be parseable. All retained debates have a non-missing plurality correctness indicator.
